# Native FitPoints geometry98

Eight requests reconstruct actual saved native ReplayCircleHistory results. Two
Face1 requests use synthetic History envelopes around genuine successful native
constructors and their immutable recorded properties: actual replay is RED.
Native topology, classes, control poles, attributes, identity stamps and parent/
own transforms are preserved. Expected point order is independently queried via
FreeCAD Python poles/Vertexes/Points, not the Rust validator.

See provenance.json and the original native report.
